home_tagline: Split shared expenses with friends. No signup.
reminder_text: Hi {name}, just a friendly reminder: you still owe me {amount} for “{group}”. {link}
group_password_intro: Enter it once and this device remembers it.
group_password_hint: On top of the link, for extra safety.
group_password_dialog_hint: Everyone with the link has to enter it once on each device, including people already in the group. Share it with them yourself.
field_other_members: Who else is in the group?
share_hint: Anyone with this link can view and edit the group.
regenerate_confirm: The current link will stop working for everyone. Continue?
regenerate_hint: Use this if the link reached the wrong people.
error_not_found: This group doesn't exist, or its link was replaced. Ask a member for the current link.
error_group_name_too_long: The group name is too long.
error_member_name_taken: Each member needs a different name.
converted_looking_up: Looking up the day's exchange rate…
converted_rate_later: No exchange rate right now; it's looked up when you save.
rate_source: Daily reference rates of the European Central Bank (via Frankfurter), worked out through the euro, for the expense’s date.
error_expense_title_required: Enter what the expense was for.
error_amount_invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, like 12.50.
error_rate_invalid: Couldn't get the exchange rate right now. Try again in a moment.
error_odometer_invalid: Enter the odometer reading as a number, like 12480.
error_litres_invalid: Enter the litres as a number, like 41.27.
error_payers_too_few: Enter what at least two people paid.
error_payers_mismatch: What everyone paid has to add up to the amount.
error_participants_required: Choose at least one person to split with.
insights_tap_hint: Tap a column for its amount
insights_empty: Add a few expenses to see where the money goes.
insights_customize_hint: Shown for everyone in this group.
section_over_time_hint: Spending by day, week or month
section_fixed_hint: Rent, bills and subscriptions with their trend
section_driving_hint: Odometer, km driven, cost per km, consumption and fuel price
section_biggest_hint: The five largest, without fixed costs
section_who_pays_hint: Paid vs. share for each person
section_how_often_hint: Who paid how often, and whose turn it is
section_position_hint: Owed to you or owing, and how it changed
section_settling_hint: Paid back, still open, and since when
activity_group_password_set: {who} set a password for the group
error_payment_details_too_long: That's too long (200 characters at most).
error_member_taken: Someone else is already this member.
device_intro: Create a link and open it on your other phone or computer within 15 minutes. It works once, and that device will then be you in all your groups.
device_qr_hint: Scan this with your other phone’s camera, or share the link.
device_adopt_intro: This device will be you in all your groups, just like the one that created the link.
error_device_link_invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Create a new one on your other device.
error_device_not_found: That device isn't one of yours anymore.
device_remove_text: That device won't be you anymore and no longer sees your groups. You can add it again with a new link.
recovery_intro: If you lose all your devices, this key brings you and all your groups back. Keep it somewhere safe, like a password manager. Anyone who has it can be you.
recovery_replace_hint: Creating a new key makes any older one stop working.
recovery_shown: Your recovery key. Save it now; it won't be shown again.
recovery_outdated: Your recovery key is older than your encrypted groups, so it can’t bring back their keys. Create a new one.
restore_intro: Lost your device or cleared your browser? Enter your recovery key to be you again on this device.
restore_done: Welcome back. Your groups are on the start screen.
error_recovery_key_invalid: That recovery key doesn't match. Check it for typos.
passkey_intro: The easiest way back: save a passkey with your fingerprint, face or screen lock. Your phone or password manager keeps it in sync, so on any new device you just continue with it. No account, no password.
passkey_unsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. Use a recovery key instead.
error_passkey_failed: That didn't work. If you cancelled, just try again.
home_empty: No groups yet. Start one and share the link with the people you split costs with.
error_kind_invalid: Choose a type for the group.
error_split_mode_invalid: Choose how to split the expense.
error_split_input_invalid: Check the numbers for each person.
error_split_amounts_mismatch: The amounts per person need to add up to the total.
error_split_items_empty: Add at least one item with a price.
error_split_items_over: The items add up to more than the amount.
error_split_percent_mismatch: The percentages need to add up to 100%.
error_split_adjust_too_large: The differences are larger than the total.
items_left: {amount} left over, like tip or tax: shared in proportion.
offline_banner: You're offline. Saved pages can be viewed; changes need a connection.
default_split_remember: Use this split for new expenses
simplify_debts_hint: Settle up with the fewest payments: if Anna owes Ben and Ben owes Cara, Anna pays Cara directly.
error_import_not_splitwise: This doesn't look like a Splitwise export. In Splitwise, open the group and choose “Export as spreadsheet”.
error_import_empty: There's nothing to import in this file.
error_import_too_large: This file is too large to import.
error_backup_invalid: This isn’t a Keeping Tabs backup, or the file is damaged.
error_import_people_invalid: Choose a different member for each person, or add them as new members.
backup_restore_intro: A backup becomes a new group with a new link. Everyone chooses who they are again; the group it came from stays as it is.
import_intro: Bring a group's history over from Splitwise. In Splitwise, open the group's settings and choose “Export as spreadsheet”, then pick that CSV file here.
import_skipped: {count} rows can't be imported (another currency or incomplete).
import_people_hint: Match the people in the export with this group's members.
import_again_hint: Rows imported before are skipped, so you can import a newer export again later.
error_member_has_taken_part: You've already added or changed things in this group, so this is you now.
error_member_not_settled: Only people who are settled up can be removed, so no debt gets lost.
person_lost_access: {name} lost access: let them join again
person_remove_not_settled: {name} can be removed once settled up
not_you_hint: You can still switch, as long as you haven't added or changed anything here.
you_for_good: That's you here now. Lost your phone? Keep your groups with a passkey or recovery key.
error_group_deleted: This group was deleted. Its members can restore it from their start screen within {days} days of deleting it.
rate_limited: Lots going on at once. Please wait a minute and try again.
error_unexpected: That didn't work. Please try again in a moment.
log_out_intro: For a shared or borrowed device. Your account and your other devices stay as they are.
log_out_explain: This device forgets your groups and their keys. You can come back with another device, a passkey or a recovery key.
log_out_only_way: This is your only way in. Without another device, a passkey or a recovery key, you can’t get back to your groups.
delete_identity_intro: Remove everything that ties you to this app: your identity, passkeys, device links and recovery key. Your groups and their expenses stay for the others; you show up as "not here yet".
delete_identity_explain: This can't be undone. You'll be signed out here and on all your devices, and you can't get your groups back with a passkey or recovery key anymore.
delete_identity_anonymize: Also replace my name in groups with "Former member"
delete_group_explain: The group disappears for everyone. Any member can restore it from the start screen for {days} days; after that it is gone for good.
delete_now_text: It's removed for everyone in the group, with all its expenses. This can't be undone.
error_group_not_restorable: This group can't be restored anymore.
push_hint: A notification on this device when someone else adds an expense.
push_failed: That didn’t work. Check your connection and try again.
push_test_sent: Sent. It should appear in a moment; if not, check your phone’s notification settings for this app.
push_test_none: This device isn’t registered yet. Turn notifications off and on again.
push_test_refused: The push service refused it ({status}). Turn notifications off and on again.
push_ios_hint: On an iPhone, add the app to your home screen first.
push_blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
settings_name_hint: The name we suggest when you create or join a group.
payment_details_hint: Shown to people in your groups when they pay you back.
avatar_hint: Shown wherever you appear, in every group.
settings_display_currency_hint: Amounts show in this currency, at today’s rate. You still enter and pay in the group’s currency.
welcome_intro: Keeping Tabs is a small app among friends. Enter the password you got from whoever told you about it.
welcome_wrong: That's not it. Ask the friend who told you about the app.
welcome_link_hint: Got a link to a group? Just open it, no password needed.
how_no_account_text: There’s no sign-up. Your device gets its own identity the first time you use the app, and that’s all it takes.
how_joining_text: Every group has a secret link. Share it with the people in the group: whoever opens it picks who they are and is in. Treat the link like a key, and make a new one if it gets out.
how_splitting_text: Add what you paid and who it’s for. The app keeps track of who owes whom and suggests the fewest payments to settle up. Mark a payment once it’s made.
how_devices_text: Your groups stay with this device. To have them on another phone or after losing this one, save a passkey or a recovery key, or link your other device while you still have this one.
how_private_text: Groups are end-to-end encrypted: names, text, amounts and photos can only be read on the devices of people with the group’s link. The server still sees when things happen and how big a group is. There’s nothing to set up, but if everyone loses the link and their devices, a group can’t be recovered.
encrypted_note: Encrypted. Only people with the link can read this.
push_new_expense_sealed: A new expense in one of your groups
error_import_encrypted: That couldn’t be imported. Open the group’s link on this device and try again.
error_offline_group_encrypted: This group was encrypted after you saved this offline, so it couldn’t be sent. Please add it again.
backup_nudge_text: Save a passkey or recovery key, so you can get back into your groups if this browser forgets them.
rekey_intro: Someone shouldn’t follow this group anymore? This makes a new link, and the old one stops working.
rekey_warning: Everyone else then needs the new link, once on each device. Send it to them afterwards.
encrypt_failed: That didn’t finish. Nothing is lost: try again.
encrypt_done: Done. Now send the new link to everyone in the group.
locked_title: Open this group with its link
locked_intro: This group can only be read with its full link. Open that link on this device, or paste it here.
locked_group_hint: Open its link to see this group
locked_cannot_save: This device can’t read this group yet. Open the group’s link first.
locked_reload: This group has changed. Reload the page and try again.
note_text: Your groups are end-to-end encrypted: names, titles, notes, comments, amounts, categories and photos can only be read on your devices and those of people with the group’s link. The server still sees that a group exists, how many people are in it, and when things are added. It also delivers the app itself, so you’re trusting it not to change that. While a group from before this update switches over, the server can still read it, for 90 days at most.
section_budget_hint: Spent against the budget, and where this pace leads
budget_hint: Set a budget and an end date to see where this pace leads.
section_highlights_hint: A few facts worth knowing, when there are some
highlight_streak: {days} days in a row with expenses, from {date}
section_recap_hint: Once it's over: the whole thing in a few numbers
spending_total: Your share across all your groups
spending_shared_hint: Your share of what you took part in together
section_kind_months_hint: Each month: fixed costs and what came on top
section_places_hint: Where you go again and again
placeholder_description: e.g. Our week by the sea
receipt_needs_connection: Photos need a connection. You can add them once you’re back online.
error_expense_note_too_long: That note is too long (500 characters at most).
error_comment_too_long: That comment is too long (500 characters at most).
error_receipt_invalid: That photo couldn’t be read or stays too large.
error_receipt_limit: There are enough photos here already. Remove one first.
